# Playable World Requirements Quality Checklist: Playable Zoo World

**Purpose**: Pre-implementation requirements quality gate validating completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and edge-case coverage across the Panda Forest world, third-person avatar locomotion, desktop/mobile controls, camera/collision boundaries, environmental interactions, and runtime architecture contracts.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Environment & Collision Boundary Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are all required environmental elements of the Panda Forest (walking paths, bamboo vegetation, rocks, trees, pond, and decorations) explicitly enumerated with clear scope exclusions for animal models? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Are the physical collision boundaries for both the outer perimeter enclosure and the blocked pond shoreline unambiguously specified so traversable vs. non-traversable zones are clear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §2.2]
- [x] CHK003 Are collision response expectations defined for angled approaches and jumps against solid environmental props (rocks, trees, bamboo clusters, fences) to prevent avatar snagging or geometry penetration? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Are default player spawn coordinates and initial facing orientation specified consistently across the specification and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §2.2]

## Player Avatar & Locomotion Requirements

- [x] CHK005 Are the entry and exit conditions for all four locomotion states (`Idle`, `Walking`, `Running`, `Jumping`) completely and deterministically defined without overlapping transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §1.1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the requirement for the avatar to face the direction of movement quantified with a measurable angular response threshold and defined relative to camera yaw? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK007 Are walking speed, running speed, jump impulse velocity, and gravity parameters consistently specified between the data model and core controller contracts? [Consistency, Data Model §1.1, Contracts §game-core-contracts]
- [x] CHK008 Are mid-air input edge cases (repeated jump inputs while airborne and holding/releasing Run mid-jump) explicitly addressed in the requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §1.1]

## Camera & Obstacle Avoidance Requirements

- [x] CHK009 Are the horizontal orbit range (360 degrees), vertical pitch clamp bounds, and minimum/maximum zoom distance thresholds explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §1.2]
- [x] CHK010 Is the camera obstacle avoidance behavior (pulling forward in front of obstructions and restoring target zoom distance once clear) specified with minimum distance and safety margin rules? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contracts §game-core-contracts]
- [x] CHK011 Can camera anti-clipping requirements adjacent to trees, rocks, and perimeter walls be objectively measured against the defined acceptance criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Cross-Device Input & Control Parity Requirements

- [x] CHK012 Are desktop mouse and keyboard control requirements—specifically free-look pointer lock during gameplay, holding `Alt` to temporarily reveal the cursor for HUD clicks, and pressing `ESC` to open the menu—unambiguously specified without conflicting browser key behaviors? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK013 Are mobile touch control requirements explicitly defined so the virtual joystick governs directional walking and a dedicated on-screen `Run` button controls running speed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK014 Does the unified input abstraction contract specify normalized movement vector clamping ($\le 1.0$) so diagonal movement is not faster than cardinal movement on desktop or mobile? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Data Model §1.3]
- [x] CHK015 Are input reset requirements defined when the browser window loses focus, changes visibility, resizes, or opens the settings menu? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts §runtime-and-assets-contracts]

## Environmental Interaction Requirements

- [x] CHK016 Are the minimum count ($\ge 3$) and required archetypes (`info_plaque` and `world_prop`) of interactive objects in the Panda Forest explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK017 Is the disambiguation rule for selecting a single primary target when the player stands within range of multiple overlapping interactive objects clearly defined? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Are the expected feedback behaviors for both interaction archetypes (UI info card overlay vs. 3D world prop visual/animation state change) and their dismissal/exit conditions clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018, US3]
- [x] CHK019 Is the prompt appearance latency threshold quantified so interaction detection responsiveness can be objectively evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Session Flow, HUD, Settings & Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK020 Are requirements for the entry/loading screen, minimal gameplay HUD, and `ESC`/touch Settings Menu (including camera sensitivity and audio mute/volume controls) completely specified across desktop and mobile viewports? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK021 Are persistence scope and validation bounds for user settings (`localStorage` device-local retention without requiring authentication) consistent with the out-of-scope boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §Assumptions, Data Model §3.2]
- [x] CHK022 Are frame-rate targets (60 FPS desktop, 30–60 FPS mobile), initial load time threshold ($<10\text{s}$), and adaptive rendering quality requirements quantified with measurable criteria? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-007, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK023 Do the architectural contracts explicitly define the separation between 60 Hz mutable frame state and discrete reactive UI state to prevent unnecessary React re-renders during the game loop? [Completeness, Plan §Architectural Decisions, Contracts §runtime-and-assets-contracts]
- [x] CHK024 Are deterministic initialization, resize handling, and resource disposal requirements specified for repeated mounting and unmounting of the 3D runtime? [Coverage, Plan §Architectural Decisions, Contracts §runtime-and-assets-contracts]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
